name: Ingrid Halvorsen
bio: Former concert-hall programmer. Sequences ambient records the way other people sequence arguments.

notes.note: Ambient for daylight. No drone longer than the kettle takes; this is a list to do something else to.
Oslo in the blue hour, which in winter is most of the afternoon. Rasmus, Halvor and Zoning & Census are all neighbours.
Modern composition for strings, mostly. Two of these were recorded in the same church, eleven years apart. You can hear the roof.
